headline: Brazil Insurer Porto Reports 14% Profit Decline in Third Quarter
summary: Porto, a Brazilian insurance and banking firm, reported a 14% drop in recurring profit to $131 million. The company also increased its credit-loss forecast for 2026.
why: Porto is a major player in the Brazilian insurance and financial services market; its earnings and credit-loss provisions provide insight into the health of the Brazilian consumer credit environment.

impacts.name: Porto
impacts.why: The company reported a decline in quarterly profit and increased its credit-loss forecast.
